families.name: refuses wrong response MIME after the adjacent real positive

families.name: returns exactly 65536 bytes and refuses a finite 65537-byte reply

families.name: uses the unchanged 10000 ms client default against an owned stalled response
families.limit: Real default retained; actual AbortError/code and measured elapsed time. No exact scheduler or DNS/fallback time bound is asserted.

controls.firstWitness: Direct literal 0101ff bit assertion after full non-bit request prefix; full expected hex and the policy case are later independent assertions.
controls.masking: Earlier nonce or prefix failures mask the bit witness; no result or sensitivity is predicted.

controls.firstWitness: Actual Promise rejection after the adjacent real positive; count and finally assertions follow.
controls.masking: If cleanup is clean, the same primary AssertionError object is rethrown unchanged. Real cleanup failures produce AggregateError with primary first; no invented cleanup failure or sensitivity credit.
